meta.title: 4-Day Fes, Chefchaouen & Volubilis Tour | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A 4-day shared group tour round-trip from Fes — Meknes, the Roman ruins of Volubilis, and two nights in the blue streets of Chefchaouen. From €338pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, fixed-date group tour from Fes through Meknes, Volubilis, and Chefchaouen's blue medina. From €338pp.

overview.h2: Northern Morocco at a slower pace
paras: This loop out of Fes trades desert dunes for imperial history and mountain color — the royal stables of Meknes, the Roman ruins of Volubilis, and two full nights in the blue-washed lanes of Chefchaouen, all shared with a small group.
Total driving distance is around 520 km round trip, spread over four days so no single day feels rushed.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Fes medina exploration
paras: Group welcome in Fes. Guided walk through the Fes el-Bali medina — tanneries, souks, and the Bou Inania Madrasa. Overnight in Fes.

days.label: Transfer
days.title: Fes to Chefchaouen via Meknes and Volubilis
paras: Morning stop in Meknes (60 km/1 hr) for the royal stables and Bab Mansour gate, then on to the Roman ruins of Volubilis (30 km/30 min). Continue north through the Rif Mountains to Chefchaouen (≈230 km/4 hrs). Overnight in Chefchaouen.

days.label: Chefchaouen
days.title: Chefchaouen blue medina
paras: Full free day to wander the blue-washed lanes at your own pace, with an optional guided hike to the Spanish Mosque viewpoint above town for sunset. Overnight in Chefchaouen.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Chefchaouen back to Fes
paras: Scenic drive back south through the Rif foothills, arriving in Fes by early evening for onward travel. Trip ends.

intro: Three nights, shared throughout. Expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each town.

cards.title: Night 1 · Fes
html: A budget medina hostel in the same bracket as Moroccan Dream Hostel or Riad Verus — shared or twin rooms in a traditional courtyard house, walking distance to the tanneries.

cards.title: Nights 2–3 · Chefchaouen
html: A small blue-medina guesthouse similar to Bleu Home or Pension Soukia — simple, clean rooms a short walk from the main square, often with a shared kitchen or rooftop terrace.

cards.title: Private upgrade
html: Private rooms are available on all three nights as a paid upgrade — let us know at booking, subject to availability.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Guided walks in Fes and Meknes, entry to Volubilis
excludes: Royal stables and tannery viewing-point fees (small cash payments)
Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

good.h2: The blue city, without the rush
paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every Monday year-round — this route pairs well with our 7-Day Morocco Highlights tour if you're arriving into Fes from the south.
Prefer to start from Chefchaouen or Tangier instead? Ask us — we can sometimes adjust the pickup point.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: How much free time is there in Chefchaouen?
items.a: A full day and two nights — enough time to wander the blue lanes at your own pace, shop, and hike to the Spanish Mosque viewpoint without feeling rushed.
Yes — it's one of Morocco's best-preserved Roman sites, with mosaics still visible in situ. The stop is roughly 45 minutes to an hour.

items.q: Can I join this trip from Marrakech?
items.a: This route is fixed round-trip from Fes, but many travelers combine it with our 7-Day Morocco Highlights tour, which ends in Fes and includes Chefchaouen as an optional add-on.

items.q: Is accommodation shared for all 3 nights?
items.a: Yes, the €338 price is based on shared twin/dorm rooms throughout. A private room upgrade is available on request, subject to availability.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed weekly dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
